  1. OpenVINO on CPU

OpenVINO on CPU

The OpenVINO Model Server gives efficient CPU inference for OpenVINO IR, ONNX, and TensorFlow models, and can also run small text-generation models. It is the chart default for modelDefaults.runtime.

Complete values file 

namespace: models

clusterServingRuntimes:
  openVINO:
    enabled: true
    name: kserve-openvino
    image: openvino/model_server:2026.3
    imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
    resources:
      requests:
        cpu: "2"
        memory: 4Gi
      limits:
        cpu: "4"
        memory: 8Gi
  vllmCPU:
    enabled: false

modelDefaults:
  runtime: kserve-openvino
  modelFormat: huggingface
  resources:
    requests:
      cpu: "4"
      memory: 16Gi
    limits:
      cpu: "8"
      memory: 32Gi

models:
  - name: ovms-gemma-3-4b
    storageUri: hf://OpenVINO/gemma-3-4b-it-fp16-ov
    args:
      - --task=text_generation
      - --target_device=CPU
      - --log_level=INFO
      - --cache_size=2

Install:

helm upgrade --install model-serving helm-charts/model-serving \
  --namespace kserve --create-namespace -f openvino-values.yaml

Pre-converted models

Models under the OpenVINO organization on Hugging Face are already converted to OpenVINO IR and load fastest.

models:
  - name: ovms-gemma-4-e2b
    storageUri: hf://OpenVINO/gemma-4-E2B-it-fp16-ov
    args:
      - --task=text_generation
      - --target_device=CPU

  - name: ovms-gemma-4-e4b
    storageUri: hf://OpenVINO/gemma-4-E4B-it-fp16-ov
    args:
      - --task=text_generation
      - --target_device=CPU

ONNX models 

models:
  - name: resnet-onnx
    runtime: kserve-openvino
    modelFormat: onnx
    storageUri: s3://models/vision/resnet50
    resources:
      requests:
        cpu: "2"
        memory: 4Gi
      limits:
        cpu: "4"
        memory: 8Gi

TensorFlow models 

models:
  - name: recommender-tf
    runtime: kserve-openvino
    modelFormat: tensorflow
    storageUri: s3://models/recommender/v2

Useful arguments

Argument Purpose
--task=text_generation Selects the generation pipeline
--target_device=CPU Execution device; AUTO and GPU also exist
--cache_size=2 Key-value cache size in GB for generation
--log_level=DEBUG Verbose logs while diagnosing
--nireq=4 Number of concurrent inference requests

Performance notes

CPU inference scales with physical cores. Give the pod whole cores and keep requests equal to limits for predictable latency:

    resources:
      requests:
        cpu: "8"
        memory: 32Gi
      limits:
        cpu: "8"
        memory: 32Gi

Pin thread counts when the node is shared:

    env:
      - name: OMP_NUM_THREADS
        value: "8"

Verify 

kubectl get inferenceservice -n models
kubectl port-forward -n models svc/ovms-gemma-3-4b-predictor 8080:80

curl -s http://localhost:8080/openai/v1/completions \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model": "ovms-gemma-3-4b", "prompt": "Kubernetes is", "max_tokens": 64}'

For a classification or vision model:

curl -s http://localhost:8080/v1/models/resnet-onnx:predict \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"instances": [[[0.1, 0.2, 0.3]]]}'
